content: Cargo features must be additive: enabling a feature may not remove functionality or change a type's shape, because feature unification means any dependent in the graph can turn one on. Resolver v2 (RFC 2957) reduces but does not remove unwanted unification. docs.rs builds need [package.metadata.docs.rs] all-features = true plus #[cfg_attr(docsrs, doc(cfg(...)))] to label gated items. Feature combinations must be tested explicitly (cargo hack --feature-powerset) because a cfg-gated import that is missing under one combination only fails as E0432 in that combination.
